name: live_levelup
description: Level-ups, skill points and perks are each player's own. The guest earns 300 XP and closes its level-up menu with 10 points in Guns (AV 41) and the Intense Training perk (coop levelup: the interaction act the guest's level-up menu sends, run on the host in the guest's shadow by progress::level_up). Both peers see the guest at level 2 with one perk and 10 skill points. The host player stays at level 1 with no perk and no points: the party sums (guest plus host) are 3 levels, 1 perk and 10 points.
